scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently --kill-others --names shared,be,fe "npm run dev -w @qforge/shared" "npm run dev -w @qforge/backend" "npm run dev -w @qforge/frontend"
scripts.dev:be: npm run build:shared && concurrently --kill-others --names shared,be "npm run dev -w @qforge/shared" "npm run dev -w @qforge/backend"
scripts.dev:fe: npm run build:shared && concurrently --kill-others --names shared,fe "npm run dev -w @qforge/shared" "npm run dev -w @qforge/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @qforge/backend && npm run build -w @qforge/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @qforge/backend
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
